subject.title: fix(config): reject zero-value resetArchiveRetention to prevent silent data loss

question: Should doctor migrate a zero `session.maintenance.resetArchiveRetention` value to explicit `false`, or remove it so archive retention inherits `pruneAfter`?
rationale: Both eliminate immediate deletion, but they produce materially different upgrade behavior: indefinite retention versus the configured/default pruning window, and the current patch claims the former while implementing the latter.

options.title: Preserve archives indefinitely
options.body: Rewrite the field to `false`, update focused migration assertions, and retain the PR’s stated no-automatic-retention behavior.

options.title: Inherit pruneAfter
options.body: Continue removing the field, but change doctor output, tests, PR text, and proof to state that reset archives use the configured or default `pruneAfter` window.

recommendation.title: Preserve archives indefinitely
recommendation.body: Rewrite the field to `false`, update focused migration assertions, and retain the PR’s stated no-automatic-retention behavior.

likelyOwner.reason: They introduced the central session-maintenance and archive-retention behavior whose upgrade policy is being changed.
